_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `slug` is ALSO upstream's own name (Vercel's next-forge): where the tree names the template — its GitHub repository, next-forge.com, the words "Vercel's next-forge" — the rebrand protects it, and everywhere else the slug is this product's (the Workers, the secret project, the Terraform `repo`). `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in packages/seo/site.ts (upstream's placeholder brand, "Acme Inc"); `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in this repository's source link.
